messages:
Aya Kim: hi folks — Aya here (she/her), starting on Growth Product today. based in KST, usually online 10:00–18:00 KST. quick Qs: who do I ping for MDM enrollment? need dev/staging API keys and read access to growth-events dataset. also curious who my onboarding buddy is. fun fact: I make boba at home and bring jars to meetups :)

Ravi (Buddy): welcome Aya!! :tada: Im Ravi, your buddy for the first month. Ill DM to set up a 30-min intro. For growth-events access, ping Nina (data infra) and include ticket id once you open the request.

IT-Bot: Automated message: MDM invite sent to aya.kim@redwood at 09:12. If not received, visit https://intranet.redwood/mdm-enroll and re-open Company Portal. For API keys, use https://intranet.redwood/access -> template: "dev-api-key" and set expiry to 7d for initial work.

Aya Kim: I see the MDM invite, thanks. opening the access request now with note: "purpose: onboard - run smoke analyses on growth funnels".

Nina L.: hey Aya  welcome! Ill approve the growth-events read access once the ticket shows up. We have a demo dataset `growth_events_play` if you need quick creds for experiments. Also weekly growth stand-up Tues 9am PT.

Marta (People Ops): welcome Aya :balloon: welcome kit & stickers shipped. If you prefer a linux laptop instead of the default macbook, reply here. New-hire orientation invite sent. We also have an informal welcome lunch on Friday — bring boba if youd like!

Aya Kim: thanks everyone  requested linux 14" and added the access ticket (G-7892). Ravi awesome, 30-min intro works for me. Also Ill definitely bring a small jar of brown-sugar boba for the office lunch :boba:

Ravi (Buddy): perfect  sending calendar invite for Tue 11:00 KST / Mon 18:00 PT. Looking forward to the boba and pairing on a first PR.

IT-Bot: Noted ticket G-7892. Provisioning demo creds after approval.

Aya Kim: great, thanks y'all — Ill poke into #growth and say hi there. :)
